planned.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Native landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG. ONE full-detail V2 LOCATION KEY exterior: bomi_room/outside.png, the small FAMILY RESTAURANT in a Mangwon-dong ALLEY in Seoul at NIGHT, with Bomi's room upstairs. This is the October 25 rebuilt story. No person or character is visible, in the alley or behind the glass.

The first reference is the APPROVED Arc 1 Mapo rooftop NIGHT key, for local residential forms, drawn night atmosphere and warm practical-light/cool-night colour. The second is the APPROVED Mapo rooftop daytime key, for local building construction, concrete/stucco wear and city detail only, not daylight. Images 3-4 are APPROVED acting HOUSE STYLE anchors: match their crisp black ink, tapered contours, muted flat colours and hard cel shadows, not their characters, clothing, fortress rooms, lighting or text. This is a NEW street-level restaurant, not the rooftop room. No L8, L10 or other unapproved inbox image is a reference.

A little ordinary two-storey restaurant building in a narrow lived-in Mangwon alley, modest brick and worn pale stucco among closely packed low-rise neighbours. The ground floor has a wide glass storefront and one ordinary closed 2.1m entrance door. A broad plain faded signboard over the restaurant is completely BLANK, no Korean characters, letters, numbers, food icons or logos. Through the ground-floor glass, show a few small simple dining tables with their CHAIRS TURNED UPSIDE DOWN ON THE TABLETOPS, the chair legs pointing up: the shop has CLOSED for the night. Correct attached chair legs and believable balanced support, not a random pile or floating furniture. No diners, cook, owner or ghostly human reflection.

Directly ABOVE the restaurant, ONE small upstairs WINDOW is WARM-LIT, the only lit upper window on this building. It suggests Bomi awake in her small streaming room; do not show Bomi or a screen/person through it. Any other upper window is dark. The restaurant interior itself is dark after closing, with enough dim reflected alley light through the glass to read the inverted chairs; no bright open-for-business interior. A few practical connected details: rain pipe, air-con outdoor unit fixed to a wall, neatly supported utility cables, shallow doorstep, plain flowerpot by the door. Every cable, pipe and bracket connects plausibly. The neighbours recede down the narrow alley, their signs blank and windows mostly dark. No fancy cafe branding, neon, crowds, market stalls or parked vehicle blocking the storefront.

Camera at a normal adult eye height about 1.6 m, from a little diagonally across the alley so both the ground shop and its upstairs lit window fit comfortably in the frame. Wide establishing composition, no fisheye. One consistent horizon, wall verticals and receding alley edges; ordinary scale, 3m storeys, 0.75m table tops and 2.1m doors. The little building reads as a real small restaurant with rooms upstairs, not a toy facade or high-rise. A cropped wall or pipe at one foreground edge adds depth without hiding the required storefront.

Named key light: a small WARM alley lamp off picture-left softly lights the storefront with orange #F0B064; the single upstairs window adds a warm local accent. Deep night navy #1B2440 and subdued blue-grey fill keep the alley dark. Light and colour wash only come from these practical sources, no broad fog, sunset or blue magic. A little damp pavement can catch restrained drawn reflections, but no rainstorm or 3D glossy wash. Keep clear hand-inked outlines, flat local material colour and a few large cool hard-edged cel shadows. Full environmental detail because it is a location key; no photographic texture or CGI rendering. No text, letters, numbers, labels, readable signs, UI, watermark, logos or signature anywhere.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
